<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex010012026-09-2104-47-47" status="unreviewed">  <milestone n="a. 'bum pa" unit="section"/>
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'bum pa</rs> ltar na dmyig ni spyir nor dang rig pa gnyis la 'jug pa las | 'di ni rig pa sa shes rab bo || 
            gnyen ni <lb edRef="inst:4513" n="3a7"/> ldan pa'i don yin pas shes rab dang ldan pa'o | | 'gro don ni 'gro ba rnaMs kyis don du gnyer bar bya ba'i don mngon par mtho ba rang nges par legs pa'o | | rtsa lag ni de sgrub par byed pa ste | 'gro ba'i don sgrumb par byed pa'o | | des ni snying rje'i cha bshad la | snga mas shes rab kyi cha bshad pas | shes rab dang snying rte'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o || 
            <milestone n="b. lo tsha ba" unit="section"/>
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> ltar na tshig rkang phyed
            <lb edRef="inst:4513" n="3a8"/>'og ma nyid byed gos mas 'chad pas | dbyig gi bshad pa ni 'gro don ste | gser lasogs pa'i dbyig 'dod par bya ba yin pa bzhin du | mngon mtho nges legs de yang 'dod par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro || gnyen gyi bshad pa ni yang lag ste | des na mtshan gyi don bshad pas 'gro ba'i don sgrub pa snying rje 'ba' zhig gi yon tan no | | </seg></TEI>
